verdict.rationale: Evidence describes checkpointers/stores persisting thread and cross-thread data (langgraph-docs-2, langgraph-docs-3, langgraph-docs-13) but nothing documents user-facing controls for data retention policies or deletion/expiry of stored state — no TTL, purge API, or compliance/retention settings are mentioned anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: any documented deletion/purge API, retention/TTL configuration, or compliance controls for stored checkpoints and long-term memory.
